turns.question: What share of total non-cancelled order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026 came from the top three customers by revenue, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: revenue can be broken down by customer country, signup date, order status and time, but not by individual customer, so a top-three-customer share cannot be computed. The closest metrics are revenue_eur (Revenue), repeat_revenue_share (share of revenue from customers with two or more orders) and customers_distinct (Active customers).
